**Finding submitted — deviation (GOVLAW).**

- **Issue:** § 28.1 picks Singapore law *and* exclusive Singapore jurisdiction — outside the accepted list (walk-away territory) — and it directly contradicts § 28.2, which already vests exclusive jurisdiction in the New York County state and federal courts.
- **Cure (preferred level, one surgical edit):** § 28.1 now reads "This Agreement is governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York." The conflicting Singapore forum is deleted, so § 28.2's New York County exclusive venue (with its customary temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out) stands as the sole forum — no new forum language was needed and no cross-references dangle.
- **Element coverage:** New York law → addressed by the edit; New York County exclusive jurisdiction subject to temporary injunctive relief → already met verbatim in § 28.2. § 28.3's executive escalation is unobjectionable and untouched.
